meta_title: Not a Lightspeed POS Alternative: Keep It, Add Voice Ordering
meta_desc: Keep Lightspeed for guests and stock. Where your distributor has our app, speak your supply order and fix any line first. No Lightspeed POS alternative needed.

hero.h1: Not A Lightspeed POS Alternative: Restock Without Calling
hero.lead: If a distributor's rep still gets your restock by phone, say it into the VoiceOrder Solutions app instead. Order from their order guide (the products you buy from them most, at your account's pricing), read over each line, and get a confirmation on your phone. It works only if your distributor has the app.

problem.h2: Why kitchens look for an alternative to Lightspeed POS
problem.lead: Lightspeed emails each purchase order to the address you saved for that supplier. When the search for a Lightspeed POS competitor starts, the cause is sometimes the supply order, not the register.

cards.h3: When your rep works from the phone
cards.body: Lightspeed can email purchase orders, but some distributors still work from the phone. For those, Lightspeed's own help articles, for its K-Series restaurant POS, tell you to create the order there and skip the email. Then you make the call as before.

cards.h3: Pars say how much to order
cards.body: Lightspeed shows stock and par levels as you build an order, and can repeat orders on a schedule. The items on it come from suppliers you set up in Lightspeed yourself.

cards.h3: Lightspeed AI is there for questions
cards.body: Lightspeed AI takes questions on sales, servers, shifts and online-order results, and can set up a menu from a file. Supply orders are not among the topics it lists, so they still go out as an emailed purchase order or a call.

cards.h2: Keep Lightspeed's stock right while you speak orders
cards.lead: This is not a Lightspeed POS replacement. Lightspeed keeps the register and the inventory. VoiceOrder Solutions takes over one job: the call you make to a distributor, once that distributor has our app.

items.h3: Record it the way Lightspeed says for phoned orders
items.body: Lightspeed gets no copy of what you say in our app, so its stock misses that delivery until you add it. Make the order in Lightspeed with the email skipped, then receive the delivery into stock. In K-Series, you can also set that supplier to update stock levels only, so no email is offered.

items.h3: Let a low stock alert start the order
items.body: When Lightspeed flags an item that distributor carries, add it when you next order from them in our app. The alert itself stays in Lightspeed.
If Lightspeed already emails that distributor a recurring order, keep that order or speak it in our app, not both, or the same goods could arrive twice.

midcta.h3: See a supply order leave the phone and reach a distributor
midcta.body: In the 20-minute demo you see a made-up guide, an order read out with one line corrected, and what lands at the distributor.

steps.h2: From your distributor to your first order
steps.lead: Your distributor handles the account and the guide. You bring a phone.

items.body: Ask if they offer the app. If they do, they set up your account and add your guide. If you cannot find out, contact us.

items.h3: Get the app and sign in
items.body: Install it on your phone. Your guide is waiting when you log in.

items.h3: Say it, read it, send it
items.body: Speak your list, look over the lines, and tap send.

items.q: Should I look for a Lightspeed POS alternative just to place supply orders by talking?
items.a: No. Keep Lightspeed for the register, and keep its stock and purchasing tools too. If a distributor of yours offers our app, you can say what you need to them rather than call or email.

items.q: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Lightspeed POS?
items.a: Each does a different job. We take no guest orders, run no tables, take no payments and track no stock. If phoning your rep is what sent you looking for a Lightspeed POS alternative, a distributor with our app means you can speak that restock instead.

items.q: Do VoiceOrder Solutions and Lightspeed connect?
items.a: No. Each runs on its own, and neither support team covers the other. Anything you say in the app travels to your distributor, and Lightspeed never gets a copy.

items.q: Do I need Lightspeed's inventory add-on to use this?
items.a: No. Our app works the same whatever Lightspeed plan you are on, with or without its inventory tools. On Lightspeed's pricing page, advanced inventory, which holds its purchase orders, is in some plans and sold as an add-on for the rest.

items.q: If my supply order went through your app, does Lightspeed stock count the delivery?
items.a: Not by itself. Record it in Lightspeed the way you handle orders you phone, then receive it when the delivery comes in. What you save is time on the phone with your rep; entering it there takes as long as it does after a call today. If anything is short, quote the number on your confirmation to your rep.

items.q: What if I say romaine and the line shows iceberg?
items.a: Change it before you send. On the review screen, correct the item or the quantity, or delete the line. That review is the safeguard, so a quick glance can still let a mistake through. A call or a voicemail to the distributor gets no order number from us; only orders sent in the app do.

items.q: How do I get set up, and what does it cost?
items.a: The distributor opens your account with your guide in it, and most kitchens place a first order the same day. No app at your distributor yet? Then order from them as you always have, and get in touch with us: we will track down the right person to talk to. Since VoiceOrder Solutions reaches you through the distributor, ask them what it costs; we publish no price. Lightspeed lists prices for most of its plans.

items.q: Where do the Lightspeed details on this page come from?
items.a: On 9 November 2026 we read lightspeedhq.com and the K-Series help center: the restaurant, inventory, pricing and AI pages, and the articles on purchase orders. Features differ between Lightspeed's restaurant products. On that date we found nothing there about ordering from suppliers by voice, and we do not repeat their customer numbers. If something here is no longer current, tell us and we will fix it.
